text: Can we solve a Moonshot milestone on fmm-4x4x4-rank47-3x3x3-rank22: (p2) rank-47 scheme for <4,4,4> over Z/4Z, (p1) rank-48 scheme for <4,4,4> over Z or ZT, or (p3) rank >= 22 lower bound for <3,3,3> over GF(2)?

Lens 1 (p2 - Exact Hensel Linearization + Cascading Bridge-Split Flip-Graph Search): Every rank-47 Z/4Z scheme projects mod 2 to a rank-47 F2 scheme (U0,V0,W0) and lifts to Z/4Z iff the 4096x2256 F2 linear system J(U0,V0,W0)*x = R0 mod 2 is consistent; cascading bridge-splits across coplanar triples escape Kruskal's uniqueness trap to sample new rank-47 F2 orbits and reduce coker_inc to 0

Lens 2 (p1 - Rank-48 over Z / ZT via Z-Flip-Graph Reduction from Rank 49 and Triple Rewriting from DPS-48): Reduce rank-49 Z/ZT schemes (Strassen^2, Perminov-49, AlphaTensor-Z-49, Flips-49) to rank 48 over Z/ZT via signed plus-transitions, or clear the remaining eight 1/4-denominator (2,3,3)-coplanar triples of DPS-48 via non-De-Groote flip transitions

Direct GL_4(Q)^3 De Groote gauge conjugation of AlphaEvolve/DPS <4,4,4:48> to Z is impossible: by Proposition 1 of Moran-Schwartz-Yuan (arXiv:2602.13171), Tr(M_j1) = Tr(M_j2) = 1 and Tr(M_j1 * M_j2) = 1/2 are similarity invariants across the entire GL_4(C)^3 orbit

Uniform random single splits (Moosbauer flip_mm randomsplit) on isolated rank-47 F2 schemes (0 collinear pairs) fail to produce new rank-47 schemes because any split on a non-coplanar pair (r1,r2) stays inside span(u1,u2)xspan(v1,v2)xspan(w1,w2), which is disconnected from the other 45 rows and collapses back to {r1,r2} by Kruskal's uniqueness theorem
Cascading bridge-split explorer on AlphaTensor-47 and Flips-47 reaches new F2 orbits with reduced Hensel obstruction (coker_inc -> 0)
